Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used two distinct enrichment strategies: TurboID proximity labeling and FLAG-tag affinity purification. Acquisition was performed on an LTQ Orbitrap Elite using a data-dependent approach (target value of 3000 ions). No stable isotope labels were mentioned in the MS methods, and the search was performed using SEQUEST, indicating a standard label-free DDA workflow.

scope: In order to identify the binding proteins of VHL and BICD2, we enriched their binding proteins by TurboID-based proximity labeling technology and Flag pull-down assay, and performed mass spectrum analysis.

the supernatants were incubated with Streptavidin magnetic beads (Beaverbio, 22305-1) overnight at 4 °C... The eluted samples were subjected to NuPAGE 4–12% gel (Invitrogen) and sliver staining (Pierce, 24612). The excised gel segments were subjected to mass spectrum analysis.

the supernatants were enriched with anti-FLAG M2 beads (Sigma, F2426) at 4 °C overnight... The samples were subjected to NuPAGE 4–12% gel (Invitrogen) and sliver staining (Pierce, 24612). The excised gel segments were subjected to mass spectrum analysis.
